scope: Independent local raw-file authentication and scalar arithmetic; no model rerun. No exporter or scientific module imports.

bootstrap.unit: paired whole request after averaging its three timing repeats

limitations: One warm-parent fork and one training seed, with a reused development panel.
The request bootstrap conditions on fixed endpoints; three timing repeats are not independent trained models or 384 independent requests.
Witness sets contain overlapping training blocks, not independent held-out evidence.
Stored margins permit formula checks, but strongest-wrong vocabulary rivals cannot be reprojected without model work.
Production selected-update actual/shadow parameter displacement norms were not recorded; integration BETA displacement is not a production substitute.
No equivalence margin was declared; intervals crossing zero do not establish equal performance.
Secondary intervals are unadjusted; a cache-maintenance interval does not establish complete-request benefit.

findings.name: Simpson paradox
findings.disposition: No demonstrated paradox; repeat signs vary around zero. Keep new-buffer and parent-training witness sets separate because assessment changes have opposite directions.

findings.name: Ecological fallacy
findings.disposition: Request-level bootstrap and wins are distinct from aggregate ratios. Do not infer universal request benefit or independent sample size from overlapping blocks.

findings.name: Berkson selection
findings.disposition: Fixed reused first-128 panel and first-eight training witnesses limit representativeness. No outcome-conditioned filtering is applied.

findings.name: Collider bias
findings.disposition: Panel, witnesses and common feedback were fixed before branch outcomes. Do not select only repaired or faster requests for the primary comparison.

findings.name: Base-rate neglect
findings.disposition: Witness denominators retained: 44/31 original-error blocks and 488/676 original-prefix positions across new/parent sets.

findings.name: Regression to mean
findings.disposition: Compare contemporaneous CONTROL and candidate from the same warm parent; before/after fitting alone does not show the candidate adds benefit.

findings.name: Survivorship bias
findings.disposition: All 792 planned generations retained and valid; zero excluded invalids. Historical failed qualification remains a failed diagnostic.

findings.name: Look-elsewhere effect
findings.disposition: Primary latency interval crosses zero. Secondary intervals are unadjusted; cache-maintenance change and favorable witness metrics cannot replace the primary outcome.

findings.name: Garden of forking paths
findings.disposition: Prespecified counts, endpoints, seed and paired estimator retained. Disclose the prospective numerical-contract revision and unchanged earlier gate failure.

findings.name: Correlation versus causation
findings.disposition: Controlled fork supports this fixed-run contrast, not general mechanism efficacy. Witness changes and derivative fidelity are not independent proof of serving benefit.

findings.name: Reverse causality
findings.disposition: Training precedes serving and witness origins are frozen; no reverse-time selection route found. Post-update margin associations do not identify a causal mediator.
